question: Hello, Oda-sensei. I know you're busy watching , but I hope you'll answer my question. What does it mean when people mention directions like 9 o'clock or 12 o'clock in your manga? Behind You
answer: Well, just imagine a clock with you in the middle. 12 o'clock is right in front of you, 6 o'clock is right behind you. You just think of the ship the same way. There's no east west north south, you just use the directions you see. (Note: Waratte Iitomo! (It's Okay to Laugh!) is a Japanese variety show)
